summary: An Abu Dhabi real estate agency appears to lose enquiries to garbled welcome copy, a free builder address and no WhatsApp.

findings.problem: The welcome text appears to include a garbled sentence, We accept that the organization we would not be able to employ individuals.
findings.cost: A visitor reading the first paragraph sees broken English, and doubts the agency's professionalism.

findings.problem: The site appears to run on a free Wix address, with a Wix banner on the page.
findings.cost: A free builder address looks temporary for a real estate agency.

findings.problem: The homepage appears to run a long text about why to live in Abu Dhabi before showing a listing.
findings.cost: Buyers and tenants come to see properties, and a wall of text sends them to the big portals.
findings.fix: Featured listings and a search at the top.

findings.problem: The page shows a Call us number, but no WhatsApp appears.
findings.cost: Renters in Abu Dhabi message first, and the agent who replies first wins the viewing.
findings.fix: A one tap WhatsApp button and an enquiry form.
